hero.body: I explore the intersection of software, design and difficult questions. I use projects to test ideas, develop technical judgment and document what actually works.
hero.note: AN OPEN RECORD OF CURIOSITY → EXPERIMENTS → EVIDENCE

about.title: Make the thinking visible.
about.body: A project is more than a screenshot. I care about defining the right problem, trying approaches, understanding constraints and honestly documenting the outcome.
about.quote: The goal is not to look finished. The goal is to keep getting better.

points.title: Question first
points.body: Understand the problem before choosing the tool.

points.title: Build to learn
points.body: Use experiments to turn uncertainty into insight.

points.title: Evidence matters
points.body: Show decisions, artifacts and real outcomes.

writing.title: Why evidence beats a long list of awards
writing.body: A thoughtful project includes the challenge, choices, trade-offs and a record of what changed. The strongest portfolios show that thinking.

writing.title: Design as a form of engineering judgment
writing.body: The interface is part of the system. Good design helps users understand what matters, what happens next and why it works.
